title: Colorectal cancer screening, adults aged 50 to 75 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer in all adults aged 50 to 75 years.

action: Screen for colorectal cancer using one of the listed methods at its stated interval.

denominator.note: Age is evaluated at the end of the measurement year. This is an implementation choice; the text does not specify it.

any.note: High-sensitivity gFOBT or FIT rows, frequency every year

derived.window: The longest stated sDNA-FIT interval is 3 y, so the window is the measurement year plus the 2 prior years ({MY-2}).
Every 10 y means the measurement year plus the 9 prior years ({MY-9}).
Every 5 y means the measurement year plus the 4 prior years ({MY-4}).
Every 5 y means the measurement year plus the 4 prior years ({MY-4}).
Every 10 y means the measurement year plus the 9 prior years ({MY-9}).
